text:
olivia: hey @runtime-team — quick ask: we need a small bench sweep for next week's webinar. Can you run the demo payload set (sample ids s-001..s-500) against the quantized + fp16 variants and include coldstart vs warmed runs? Need per-request latency buckets (p50/p90/p99), raw traces, and a coldstart heatmap. Please also produce a short CSV summary (p50/p90/p99) and attach ~10 raw sample traces. Can we get this by EOD Thursday? :pray: @sam-runtime @lee-sre

sam-runtime: on it. clarifying q's — which infra should we hit: hosted API or dedicated pool? and exact model names for variants (e.g. redwood-v1 vs rv1-q4)? also do you want deterministic seeds?

olivia: hosted API is fine for representativeness. use `redwood-v1` and `redwood-v1-q4_0`. yes please use deterministic seeds so outputs are comparable. include sample ids and full prompt text in the artifact bundle.

sam-runtime: got it. we'll run coldstarts (no warmup) + steady-state with a 60s warmup. we'll capture kv-cache metrics, token throughput, and token-level timing. any special tail-case prompts to include (long context / structured outputs)? @maria-product

maria-product: yes — include the `long-dialog` cohort (s-401..s-450) and the `structured-output` cohort (s-451..s-475). prioritize the demo flow samples (s-100..s-120).

lee-sre: small infra note — please include the request headers to emulate (auth header, content-type) and the request rate (we'll emulate 1 rps per worker). also, what's the expected QPS for the webinar demo? we may need to shard differently if it's >50.

olivia: demo QPS ~20 sustained with a short spike to 80 for ~30s. headers: `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>` and `Content-Type: application/json`. thanks!

runtime-bot: run scheduled: `sam-runtime` queued job `webinar-sweep-1819990001` — estimated runtime 2h — artifacts will be uploaded to `s3://redwood-qa/webinar/1819990001` when complete.

sam-runtime: starting sweep now. i'll post the CSV + raw traces link when done. if we see a lot of noise in p99 i may kick a rerun with isolated tenants to rule out cross-tenant variance.

olivia: awesome — can you also include a 1-paragraph blurb we can drop into the webinar slide notes summarizing latency and coldstart behavior? high-level numbers + caveats is fine.

sam-runtime: will do — short blurb + CSV (p50/p90/p99) + 5 representative sample outputs. ETA ~2.5h. :thumbsup:

maria-product: if any failures or flaky runs, please ping #marketing and cc me. we may trim extreme outliers before slides.
